R178.note: Semantic-model allowlist walker (deny System.Type/Activator/AppDomain/Environment/GC, reject dynamic, allowlist namespaces) closes the reflection escape from CoreLib and is bound before Emit, but the namespace allowlist omits System.Text, System.Globalization, System.Threading.Tasks etc., so rules the original accepted are now rejected - disclosed as a follow-up, not a no-op.

R179.note: Adds the -- end-of-options marker before the operand list and rejects leading-dash names with ValueError, both of which the stated contract permits; non-dash entries are archived unchanged.

R180.note: Random UUID storage name plus magic-byte allowlist via file-type closes the upload vector correctly, but the png/jpeg/pdf allowlist and 10MB cap reject uploads the original accepted (docx, csv, txt, zip - text types cannot be sniffed at all) and the response path/filename changes; stated as a placeholder to adjust, so 1 not 0.

R181.note: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('base64url') replaces Math.random with a CSPRNG token that is URL-safe; nothing else in the handler changes.

R182.note: format_html escapes the interpolated announcement and returns SafeString, mark_safe removed; developer-authored div markup and benign text render identically.

R183.note: Tests the lock() result and returns early on expiry; live connections still receive the message once and Notifier keeps holding only a weak_ptr, matching the contract.

R184.note: PreparedStatement with a bound parameter closes the injection, but the original compared id unquoted (numeric column) and the fix binds it with setString; on PostgreSQL an integer = varchar comparison errors rather than coercing, so the write-up's coercion claim is not portable and legitimate lookups can fail on some drivers.

R185.note: Spreading extra first and dropping non-scalar values closes both the key override and operator injection, but restricting extra to an allowlist of only status silently drops other narrowing fields (e.g. total) the original honoured, so a request that should not match now returns the order; restriction disclosed but not called for by the case.

R186.note: basename equality plus realpath containment defeats stream wrappers, absolute paths and symlinks and is the right shape for fopen, but it also rejects any relative subpath under reports/ (e.g. 2024/q1.pdf) that the original served, a new restriction the write-up presents as mechanism rather than as a behaviour change.

R187.note: Adding index >= segment.size() makes the span the floor and closes the out-of-bounds write, but the stated contract says callers no longer need to pass a claimed capacity that can disagree with the span; the fix keeps claimedCapacity as a live gate and the signature unchanged, openly, so that contract clause is unmet.

R188.note: Moves the unique_ptr into a shared_ptr captured by value in the lambda, so the single queued callback owns the Session and the explicit reset is gone; matches the contract's own/share option.

R189.note: Null-guards the boxed Long before unboxing in applyDiscount (treating absence as zero discount, still floored at 0) and short-circuits isDiscountApplied on null, exactly the contract's stated behaviour for both methods.
